name: divergent-records-unreconciled
title: Two records of one event disagree, and nothing reconciles them
description: Three instances measured in one round: a field run's summary block reports zero tokens and zero tool calls while its transcript and its ledger show sixteen provider rounds and fifteen tool observations; project bind prints status healthy and exits minus one; and the same verify command reports minus one, one and zero depending on how it is invoked, with a control proving the method. Each is a record that would let a reader conclude something false, which is the class this project keeps finding in its own declarations.
creator: aixi
